proposals.spec_text: Provide pin and unpin operations for GPU memory regions
proposals.actual_behavior: Tracks state in HashSet without CUDA pinning APIs; correct for IPC device memory
proposals.proposed_change: Update spec to clarify pin means verify device-residency + track state for IPC memory
proposals.rationale: cudaHostRegister is for host memory; IPC device memory is inherently pinned
